title: LLM Inference Server
blurb: Build the parts of an inference server around the model: cached decoding, request batching, sampling, latency metrics and a request handler with stopping rules.
intro: An inference server turns a model into an API. The steps cover one decode step with a KV cache, dynamic batching with a size cap and a timeout, per-request sampling settings, the latency metrics users feel (time to first token, time per output token), and tail percentiles from a request log. The capstone is the request handler: validation, a decode loop with end-of-sequence, stop sequences and token and context limits, streaming chunks and usage accounting.

steps.name: One decode step with a KV cache
